title: font-face-observer 1.0.0: declared "BSD", its LICENSE is the 2-clause BSD text

components.name: font-face-observer
components.evidence: package.json says "license": "BSD" (not an SPDX id). The package's LICENSE is a 2-clause BSD text ('Redistribution and use in source and binary forms ... 1. ... 2. ...', no endorsement clause) whose disclaimer says 'BY THE AUTHOR' / 'THE COPYRIGHT OWNER OR CONTRIBUTORS', so it will not match SPDX's BSD-2-Clause body exactly. It is byte-identical at cymen/font-face-observer, the npm gitHead 3ded041e4cd97f91bcfbc0fe96e74e2db7363978 (a modular repackaging of Bram Stein's Font Face Observer, per its README), and in the npm tarball (integrity = lockfile). Shipped modules: src/dom.js, src/observer.js, src/ruler.js.
